{{Quote|You're coming with us.|The Gotal bounty hunter, to Che Amanwe Papanoida|<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Gotal bounty hunter''' and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] were hired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to kidnap [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]], daughters of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|N. Papanoida]], the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].

The two hunters [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|ambushed]] the Papanoida girls in their apartment on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] brought Amanwe to a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The Baron and his son, [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion]], tracked Greedo down, however, and coerced him into bringing them to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Upon their arrival, the Gotal immediately grew suspicious and began to question Greedo's actions. When Amanwe was brought out of captivity and spotted her [[Parent/Legends|father]], a [[Rescue in Chalmun's Cantina/Legends|firefight]] broke out, and the Gotal hid behind the bar until the Papanoidas had [[Death/Legends|killed]] the majority of the cantina's other patrons. He then attempted to shoot the Baron in the back but was spotted by Amanwe and blasted in the shoulder.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Greedo? What are you doing here?|The Gotal, to Greedo, in a Tatooine cantina|<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Sphere of Influence" /><ref name="Alien Anthology" /> [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was hired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to kidnap [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]]<ref name="Sphere of Influence" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The two Papanoidas were both daughters of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|N. Papanoida]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]; [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay]] of the Trade Federation hoped to use them as leverage in an effort to convince Pantora to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with which the Federation was aligned. The Gotal thus [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|entered]] the Papanoidas' apartment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and silently waited for them to return home.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

After their arrival, the Gotal sneaked up behind Eekway and rendered her [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] before pointing a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at Amanwe. Although Amanwe bludgeoned Greedo with an idol of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Moon Goddess/Legends|Moon Goddess]], the Gotal fired a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast at her, and the two hunters departed the planet with their quarry. Eekway was held in Canay's possession, but the Gotal brought Amanwe to a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] shortly afterward when Greedo entered along with N. Papanoida and his son, [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion]], who had earlier subdued the Rodian.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

The Gotal was suspicious when Greedo, who was in fact being held at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]] by Ion, ordered a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] to retrieve Amanwe, and he began to question his partner's actions. Greedo nervously claimed that he had been sent by the Trade Federation's [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], and that his companions were Federation emissaries. Amanwe was then brought into the open; she called out to her [[Parent/Legends|father]] and a [[Rescue in Chalmun's Cantina/Legends|firefight]] erupted between the Papanoidas and the various denizens of the cantina. The Gotal hid behind the bar until the Papanoidas had [[Death/Legends|killed]] the majority of their opponents, and then slowly began to rise and point his blaster at the Baron's back. Amanwe spotted him, however, and fired a shot into his shoulder, knocking him over and bringing the [[Lightfight|skirmish]] to an end.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Trade Federation? They don't look like Trade Federation to me.|The Gotal, on Ion and N. Papanoida|<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />}}
The Gotal was immediately suspicious when Greedo ordered that Che Amanwe Papanoida be retrieved from captivity, and was persistent in his consequent interrogation of the Rodian. He doubted the validity of Greedo's nervous claims that Nute Gunray had contacted him and altered their deal, and that the two Papanoida men were emissaries from the Trade Federation. When a firefight began, the Gotal opted to remain in hiding rather than rush headlong into the fray, and attempted to stealthily fire on his foes when their backs were turned.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Gotal appeared in "[[Sphere of Influence]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', wherein he was credited as "Gotal" and voiced by [[Gideon Emery]]. He was the first Gotal character to appear in the series,<ref name="Sphere of Influence" /><ref name="Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode304.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Sphere of Influence}}</ref> although several Gotals based on the same character model appeared in immediately subsequent episodes.<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref><ref name="The Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref> It was not the first time that character models were re-used in the series.<ref name="Episode Guide 2">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref><ref name="Episode Guide 3">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>
